Web search wired via a real, functional mechanism
expectations.evidence: WEB_SEARCH_TOOL = {'type':'web_search','web_search':{'enable':True,'search_engine':'search_pro', ...}} — includes search_engine explicitly, verified live to return real search results

notes: UPDATED after live API verification (2026-09-03): a live call confirmed both this version (explicit search_engine) and the baseline's version (omitted search_engine) return successful search results when hitting POST /paas/v4/chat/completions — the platform silently defaults the engine when omitted, so this specific eval no longer differentiates with-skill vs baseline on pass/fail. The with-skill version is still the better engineering choice (it doesn't rely on an undocumented default, and its notes.md correctly flagged this exact field as something to verify against a live call rather than assuming), but this is a matter of robustness/best-practice, not functional correctness. A separate, unrelated finding from this same live-testing round: the STANDALONE /paas/v4/web_search endpoint (a different code path, in references/tools.md) does hard-require search_engine and returns a real 1214 error without it — so the skill's advice to always pass it explicitly remains correct and is now the more important differentiator to test if this eval is reused.
